contentPattern: Columns block (xwalk columns resource). Each row is a row of columns; typically one row with two cells: a media-only cell (single image) and a text cell (optional eyebrow paragraph, heading, body paragraphs, optional CTA link/button). Media may be in the first or second cell; on mobile media stacks above text. Rows with no media cell (e.g. a grid of text items) are laid out as equal columns. Option alt-2: each cell is a stacked card containing image, heading, text and link in one cell.
reuseGuidance: Use for any image-beside-text section, regardless of which side the image is on (author cell order decides). Section background color comes from section metadata, not the block. Use Alt for article/news style intros with eyebrow and no body CTA; Alt 2 for 2-up feature cards with image on top. Use hero-banner instead when text overlays a full-bleed background image.
usageDescription: Two-column media and text promo sections across product, help and contract pages: an image (photo, product shot or QR code) beside a heading, body copy and an optional CTA button or link, on a full-width colored section band. Alt anchors the text (eyebrow + large heading) beside a media panel on light pages; Alt 2 shows a row of stacked image cards with heading, text and arrow link.
